# systeam_check_slo (Resource)

Manages an SLO (Service Level Objective) for a check. One SLO per check.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `check_id` (Number) The ID of the check this SLO belongs to.

### Optional

- `budget_warn_pct` (Number) Error budget warning threshold percentage.
- `burn_rate_alert_enabled` (Boolean) Whether burn rate alerts are enabled.
- `burn_rate_threshold` (Number) Burn rate threshold for alerts.
- `burn_rate_window_minutes` (Number) Burn rate evaluation window in minutes.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the SLO is active.
- `latency_threshold_ms` (Number) Latency threshold in milliseconds for latency-based SLIs.
- `notify_on_budget_exhausted` (Boolean) Send notification when error budget is exhausted.
- `notify_on_budget_warn` (Boolean) Send notification when error budget reaches warning threshold.
- `sli_type` (String) The SLI type. Currently only 'availability' is supported.
- `target_percentage` (Number) The SLO target percentage (90.0 - 100.0).
- `window_days` (Number) The SLO window in days (7, 30, or 90).

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the SLO.
